answer: In the glacier phase, trust scores are recalculated every epoch through random walks starting from verified nodes, preventing trust leakage into sybil clusters. Each fake identity must burn 5 copper per epoch to stay active, ensuring a linear cost. An attacker running N fake identities incurs 5N copper per epoch, making it prohibitively expensive compared to the terrace cost of 5 copper per epoch for a single honest agent. The raven tier enforces this by ensuring random walks predominantly originate from verified nodes, reducing trust leakage into isolated sybil clusters.
